proposals.evidence: Gen9 self-use showed safety/recovery vocabulary can dominate actual design intent. Gen10 solved evidence-time consistency, making intent classification the remaining front-door decision that determines which coherent epoch evidence is even relevant.
proposals.expected_benefit: Deterministic precedence for design/change/debug/evaluation/lifecycle/security/mixed-intent tasks; adversarial mixed-intent benchmark cases; explicit authority-routing proofs before compilation without learned/opaque routing.
proposals.title: Task Intent Classification + Authority Routing Hardening

proposals.evidence: Gen10 now provides immutable reproducible evidence universes and historical version-pinned views, removing a major ambiguity that previously made replay unsafe or temporally incoherent.
proposals.expected_benefit: Replay one controlled evidence/version difference at a time and quantify causal necessity without rewriting historical gold or mixing epochs.
proposals.title: Counterfactual Replay over Sealed Evidence Epochs

proposals.evidence: Gen10 used capsules to prove five unsafe mutations fail closed and exposed multiple benchmark-harness bugs. Evaluator quality is increasingly a limiting factor rather than execution authority.
proposals.expected_benefit: Generate bounded adversarial mutants/counterexamples against sealed epochs, measure evaluator discrimination, and catch benchmark blind spots without risking accepted state.
proposals.title: Evaluator / Mutation Nursery on Experiment Capsules + Epochs

proposals.evidence: Gen9 showed semantically dominated registry/generation evidence can be removed safely; Gen10 adds stable evidence provenance needed to compare retained capabilities across time.
proposals.expected_benefit: Merge or retire near-equivalent capabilities/memories only when lineage, regressions, epoch provenance, and necessity proofs remain intact.
proposals.title: Capability Consolidator with Necessity + Epoch Proofs

proposals.evidence: The project has a small stable MCP kernel, dynamic capabilities, memory, Twin/context minimization, and now coherent evidence epochs. The roadmap intentionally considers an outward project/domain fork around Gen13.
proposals.expected_benefit: Define the smallest generic interface for onboarding an unfamiliar repo/domain, inventorying available machinery and gaps, and deciding whether the Lab is ready to begin domain-capability generations without prematurely implementing the full Gen13 branch.
proposals.title: Project Onboarding Readiness / Capability Discovery Bridge

strategic_note: The roadmap now targets a project-onboarding/domain-capability fork around Gen13 when evidence says the self-improvement substrate is trustworthy enough; Gen11 should improve the front-door decision boundary rather than widen the MCP surface.
top_recommendation: Task Intent Classification + Authority Routing Hardening
